import importlib.util, re, sys

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("adhd", sys.argv[1])
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)

doc = m.parse_document(open(sys.argv[2], encoding="utf-8").read())
blocks = m.parse_blocks(doc)
print("block kinds:", [b.kind for b in blocks])
raw = m.prose_all_raw(blocks)
prose_all = "\n".join(m.prose_of(b) for b in blocks if b.kind != "heading")
print("RAW:", repr(raw))
print()
print("PROSE:", repr(prose_all))
bold = [(x.group(1), len(x.group(1))) for x in re.finditer(r"\*\*([^*]+)\*\*", raw)]
print()
print("BOLD MATCHES:")
for g, n in bold:
    print("  ", n, repr(g[:80]))
print("bold_chars", sum(b[1] for b in bold))
print("total_chars", len(re.sub(r"\s", "", prose_all)))
